# **Database Entity Identification**

## **Pickup & Delivery Scheduler**

**![https://homework.study.com/cimages/multimages/16/database12634965186810977986.png][image1]**

---

## **1\. User Entity**

**Entity Name:** `USERS`

| Attribute | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| user\_id (PK) | Unique identifier for user |
| name | User name |
| phone | Contact number |
| email | Email address |
| created\_at | Account creation timestamp |

## **2\. Order Entity**

**Entity Name:** `ORDERS`

| Attribute | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| order\_id (PK) | Unique order identifier |
| user\_id (FK) | Reference to user |
| pickup\_location | Pickup address |
| delivery\_location | Delivery address |
| status | Current order state |
| priority | Order priority level |
| created\_at | Order creation time |
| updated\_at | Last status update time |

## **3\. Delivery Agent Entity**

**Entity Name:** `AGENTS`

| Attribute | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| agent\_id (PK) | Unique agent identifier |
| name | Agent name |
| phone | Contact number |
| status | Availability state |
| created\_at | Registration time |

## **4\. Assignment Entity**

**Entity Name:** `ASSIGNMENTS`

| Attribute | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| assignment\_id (PK) | Unique assignment identifier |
| order\_id (FK) | Associated order |
| agent\_id (FK) | Assigned agent |
| assignment\_status | Assignment state |
| assigned\_at | Assignment time |
| completed\_at | Completion time |

## **5\. Delivery Status Entity**

**Entity Name:** `DELIVERY_STATUS`

| Attribute | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| status\_id (PK) | Unique status record |
| order\_id (FK) | Associated order |
| status | Delivery status |
| updated\_at | Status update time |

## **6\. Event Log Entity**

**Entity Name:** `EVENT_LOGS`

| Attribute | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| event\_id (PK) | Unique event identifier |
| event\_type | Event name |
| entity\_id | Related entity reference |
| payload | Event data |
| created\_at | Event timestamp |

## **7\. System Metrics Entity**

**Entity Name:** `SYSTEM_METRICS`

| Attribute | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| metric\_id (PK) | Metric identifier |
| service\_name | Service source |
| metric\_type | Metric category |
| value | Metric value |
| recorded\_at | Timestamp |
